app.title: ZooWorkers
app.subtitle: A Cozy Animal Office Idle Game
app.tagline: A whole office of adorable animals runs one very small company.

opening.line: Every empire starts with one nut.
opening.titleNote: Cozy progress, chaotic coworkers, and one very important spreadsheet.
opening.spill: …and immediately spills coffee on the spreadsheet.

nuts.d: Your main currency. Earned passively and by collecting crates. Spent on upgrades, hires and decorations.

golden.d: Rare premium currency from milestones and prestige. Buys powerful upgrades and skills.

morale.d: Team happiness. Higher morale boosts production; coffee, decorations and good events raise it.

reputation.d: Grows as you produce. Unlocks new rooms and new teammates.

rate.d: Nuts produced per second across every room right now.

quiet.d: Softens audio and animation for calm, low-distraction play.

tip.friendship: Grows when you chat, gift coffee and keep them happy. Higher friendship boosts their output.
tip.mood: How this teammate feels right now. Emotions gently nudge their output up or down.

mute.d: Instantly silence (or restore) all music, ambience and sound effects.

music.d: Mute only the background music. Sound effects, interface and event sounds keep playing.

tip.affinity: How well this teammate works in their current room. Move them to a favourite room for a production bonus.

nav.office: Your cozy office and the team at work.
nav.shop: Buy upgrades to grow production and automation.
nav.employees: Hire, place and befriend your team.
nav.achievements: Goals to chase and their rewards.
nav.decorate: Buy decorations and arrange each room.

kernels.d: Banked through restructuring. They persist through every cycle and fund permanent skills.

office.collectHint: A crate of nuts is ready!
office.decorateHint: Drag a decoration to move it, or drop it on the tray to stow it. Buy more in the Decorate tab.
office.dragHint: Drag a teammate onto a room to move them there.

decorate.resetFull: This room is packed — stow a few pieces, then tidy up again.
decorate.moveToHelp: Choose any unlocked compatible room. This is also the keyboard and touch alternative to dragging.
decorate.wrongRoom: That belongs in {{room}} — drop it there.
decorate.dragToPlace: Drag onto the highlighted floor or wall.

reject.occupied: That spot's already taken — try just beside it.
reject.coversTeammate: That would cover a teammate — give them room.
reject.moveInside: Move it farther inside the room.
reject.incompatibleRoom: That decoration can't be placed in this room.

decorate.roomEmpty: No decorations for this room yet.
decorate.pickedHint: Tap an empty spot to place it, or tap it again to cancel.
decorate.resetRoomTip: Re-arranges every piece already in this room back to a neat default layout. Undo is right here if you preferred it your way.
decorate.resetDone: Room tidied — Undo is next to the button.

decoReact.plant: This little plant really freshens up the place.
decoReact.lamp: Cozy lighting makes all the difference.
decoReact.poster: Love what they did with the wall.
decoReact.rug: Ooh, this rug is so soft underfoot.
decoReact.aquarium: The fish are so calming to watch.
decoReact.trophy: We earned that — makes me proud.
decoReact.cushion: Just five more minutes on this…
decoReact.screen: Numbers look good on the big screen today.

shop.title: Upgrade Shop
shop.empty: Earn more nuts and reputation to unlock upgrades.

employee.byDepartmentTip: Send each teammate to their home department room.
employee.spreadTip: Distribute the team evenly across all unlocked rooms.

pip.name: Pip
pip.story: Pip started this company with one acorn and an unshakeable belief that meetings can fix anything. Confidence: maximum. Competence: negotiable.
pip.goal: Build the world's largest nut empire (and finally finish a spreadsheet).

marlow.name: Marlow
marlow.story: Marlow the capybara has never once raised their voice, panicked, or blinked during a crisis. Morale rises simply by being near them.
marlow.goal: Ensure absolutely everyone gets a proper nap.

rizzo.name: Rizzo
rizzo.story: Rizzo can find anything the company needs. Also several things it didn't. Please do not ask where the stapler went.
rizzo.goal: Source everything at a suspiciously good price.

bea.name: Bea
bea.story: Bea believes every problem can be solved with more wood. The chairs are now 40% sturdier and 60% more wooden.
bea.goal: Reinforce every single thing in the building.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.story: Corvus the crow has big ideas, most of them legally questionable, all of them extremely shiny.
corvus.goal: Make the nut brand go viral. Ethics optional.

mina.name: Mina
mina.story: Mina digs. Sometimes into the future of nut technology, sometimes into the meeting room, always with enthusiasm.
mina.goal: Discover what's beneath the basement's basement.

nixie.name: Nixie
nixie.story: Nixie the mouse thinks faster than she talks and builds machines from staplers, rubber bands, and pure confidence. Roughly 80% of them work.

otto.name: Otto
otto.story: Otto the otter keeps the books immaculate — right up until something shiny floats by. Explains the budget beautifully, then chases a paperclip.
otto.goal: Balance the books without getting distracted by shiny things.

hazel.name: Hazel
hazel.story: Hazel the hedgehog reads every contract twice and secretly adores the office chaos. Prickly on the outside, delighted on the inside.
hazel.goal: Keep the company just barely on the right side of the rules.

junie.name: Junie
junie.story: Junie the rabbit is everywhere at once and booked three meetings deep. Crates move faster simply because she's already there.
junie.goal: Deliver everything five minutes early, forever.

moss.name: Moss
moss.story: Moss the owl works the quiet hours, notices what everyone else misses, and speaks mostly in gentle, slightly unsettling observations.
moss.goal: Watch over the company while it sleeps.

fenn.name: Fenn
fenn.story: Fenn the fox could sell a walnut back to the tree it fell from. Charming, ambitious, and just a little too persuasive.
fenn.goal: Close the biggest nut deal in company history.

pingo.name: Pingo
pingo.story: Pingo the penguin keeps every parcel, pallet and nap perfectly scheduled. Cool under pressure, warm at heart.
pingo.goal: Route a thousand crates without a single delay.

canela.name: Canela
canela.story: Canela the red panda watches, notes, and protects — endlessly curious about how every little thing in the office works.
canela.goal: Fill an entire notebook with office observations.

nino.name: Nino
nino.story: Nino the office cat runs the meeting room with a purr and an iron paw. Somehow everything gets scheduled around his naps.
nino.goal: Attend every meeting without ever staying fully awake.

bia.name: Bia
bia.story: Bia the bear guards the vault and fixes what's broken with equal calm. Big paws, bigger heart — do not touch the honey stash.
bia.goal: Keep the vault safe and the snack shelf fully stocked.

quincy.name: Quincy
quincy.story: Quincy the frog catches bugs before anyone else notices them, with a tongue faster than any keyboard.
quincy.goal: Squash every last bug in the pipeline.

dorm.name: Sonny
dorm.story: Sonny the sloth reminds everyone that slow is smooth and smooth is fast. Eventually.
dorm.goal: Take the longest, most restorative break in history.

inky.name: Inky
inky.story: Inky the octopus sorts eight things at once and still has a tentacle free for coffee.
inky.goal: Sort the entire backlog before the coffee cools.

echo.name: Echo
echo.story: Echo the bat does her best thinking upside down, after everyone else has gone home.
echo.goal: Map every quiet corner of the night shift.

rosa.name: Rosa
rosa.story: Rosa the flamingo turns every launch into a runway. If it isn't fabulous, it isn't finished.
rosa.goal: Make the whole company impossibly stylish.

perry.name: Perry
perry.story: Perry the platypus sources the unsourceable. Part accountant, part secret agent, all business.
perry.goal: Track down one of everything, just in case.

axel.name: Axel
axel.story: Axel the axolotl meets every problem with a smile and the certainty that anything can grow back.
axel.goal: Discover something no one has ever grown before.

founderDesk.name: Founder's Desk
founderDesk.desc: Where it all began. One desk, one dream, one very tired squirrel.

sorting.name: Nut Sorting Department
sorting.desc: Good nuts left, broken shells right. Mostly.

morale.name: Coffee & Morale Division
morale.desc: Beanbags, snacks, and Marlow's calming presence.

procurement.name: Procurement Burrow
procurement.desc: Rizzo's domain. Inventory counts are… approximate.

construction.name: Construction Wing
construction.desc: Bea's workshop. Smells like fresh sawdust and ambition.

research.name: Human Behavior Observation Room
research.desc: For science. Definitely just for science.

meeting.name: Very Serious Meeting Room
meeting.desc: Where meetings about meetings are scheduled.

nap.name: Employee Nap Chamber
nap.desc: Productivity through rest. Marlow's proudest achievement.

basement.name: Suspicious Basement
basement.desc: There is definitely nothing weird down here.

rooftop.name: Rooftop Acorn Garden
rooftop.desc: Fresh air, actual grass, and a great view.

cafeteria.name: Nut Cafeteria
cafeteria.desc: Hot food, cold lighting. Everyone leaves happier than they arrived.

mailroom.name: Internal Mail Room
mailroom.desc: Every form in the building passes through here. Some pass through twice.

security.name: Security Office
security.desc: Eleven cameras. Twelve monitors. Nobody has explained the twelfth.

archive.name: Records Archive
archive.desc: Everything the company has ever written down, and a little more.

incubator.name: Behavioural Incubator
incubator.desc: Six pods. Six clipboards. Please do not tap on the glass.

cadence.charge: Charged — pays more with a beat between taps

tip.synergy: Boosted by {{names}} working in this room.

nutCrate.name: Nut Crate
nutCrate.hint: The original revenue stream. Pry it open, take the nuts.

sortingChute.name: Sorting Chute
sortingChute.hint: Feed it steadily and it never jams. Probably.

coffeeUrn.name: Communal Urn
coffeeUrn.hint: Refills itself. Nobody has admitted to refilling it.

purchaseLedger.name: Purchase Ledger
purchaseLedger.hint: Every line signed twice. One signature is not yours.

shellPress.name: Shell Press
shellPress.hint: Heavy work. Let the ram reset before the next pull.

centrifuge.name: Behaviour Centrifuge
centrifuge.hint: Spins a sample until it admits something.

depositWheel.name: Deposit Wheel
depositWheel.hint: Turns smoothly. Sounds like it is counting.

observationTerminal.name: Observation Terminal
observationTerminal.hint: Logs a finding each time. Some findings log themselves.

agendaBell.name: Agenda Bell
agendaBell.hint: Rings to advance the agenda. The agenda has no final item.

dreamLog.name: Dream Log
dreamLog.hint: Records what the nap room hears. Please do not read page 4.

furnaceValve.name: Furnace Valve
furnaceValve.hint: Pays in gold. Asks no questions. Neither should you.

signalDish.name: Signal Dish
signalDish.hint: Aimed at the car park. Receiving anyway.

servingLine.name: Serving Line
servingLine.hint: Keep the trays moving. Nobody minds if you are quick.

pneumaticTube.name: Pneumatic Tube
pneumaticTube.hint: Let the canister land before you send the next one.

cameraBank.name: Camera Bank
cameraBank.hint: Cycle the feeds. Occasionally one shows something useful.

documentScanner.name: Document Scanner
documentScanner.hint: One page per pass. Page 400 is missing and always has been.

incubationPod.name: Incubation Pod
incubationPod.hint: Log the reading. The reading logs you back.

production.name: Production Line {{tier}}
production.desc: Streamline the nut pipeline. +10% nut production per level.

furniture.name: Ergonomic Furniture {{tier}}
furniture.desc: Comfier chairs, happier squirrels. +6% production per level.

coffee.name: Coffee Upgrade {{tier}}
coffee.desc: Better beans, better focus. +8% production per level.

quality.name: Process Quality {{tier}}
quality.desc: Fewer broken shells. +5% production per level.

click.name: Sorting Gloves {{tier}}
click.desc: Collect crates faster. Increases click power.

autoCollector.name: Auto-Collector
autoCollector.desc: Automatically banks a fraction of production. No clicking required.

conveyor.name: Conveyor Belt
conveyor.desc: Nuts move themselves. +15% production per level.

offlineCap.name: Cold Storage {{tier}}
offlineCap.desc: Store more offline nuts. +2h offline cap per level.

reputationEngine.name: Reputation Engine
reputationEngine.desc: Grow the company's good name faster.

moraleCap.name: Morale Ceiling
moraleCap.desc: Raise the maximum morale of the office.

sorting.name: Build: Nut Sorting Department
sorting.desc: Unlock a whole new floor for sorting nuts.

vault.name: Build: Golden Nut Vault
vault.desc: Unlock the glowing Golden Nut Vault.

meeting.name: Build: Meeting Room
meeting.desc: Unlock the Very Serious Meeting Room.

mailroom.name: Open the Mail Room
mailroom.desc: Internal post. Cuts the cost of everything else in the building.

archive.name: Open the Records Archive
archive.desc: Somewhere to put the paperwork. Findings start turning up in it.

calibratedTools.name: Calibrated Tools
calibratedTools.desc: Every workstation is trued up and re-balanced. Critical taps land more often, everywhere in the building.

techniqueManual.name: Technique Manual
techniqueManual.desc: Somebody wrote down how the good days feel and had it bound. A sharper edge on every tap, in exchange for golden nuts.

muscleMemory.name: Muscle Memory
muscleMemory.desc: Staff stop looking at their hands. Combo streaks survive a longer pause before they break.

shiftRhythm.name: Shift Rhythm
shiftRhythm.desc: The whole floor works to one unspoken tempo. Streaks hold through interruptions that used to end them.

assayDesk.name: Assay Desk
assayDesk.desc: A desk whose only job is noticing value. Slightly more taps turn up a golden nut.

gildingProgramme.name: Gilding Programme
gildingProgramme.desc: Officially, a quality initiative. In practice, golden nuts appear where they did not before.

legalReview.name: Legal Review
legalReview.desc: Favourable outcomes are drafted properly. Decisions that go the company’s way pay more; the ones that do not are unchanged.

negotiationTraining.name: Negotiation Training
negotiationTraining.desc: The company stops accepting first offers. A much larger share of every good decision.

standardProcedures.name: Standard Procedures
standardProcedures.desc: Written down once, followed everywhere. Every department performs as though better staffed than it is.

internalAudit.name: Internal Audit
internalAudit.desc: A department that improves other departments by reading them. Substantially more from every room, staffed or thin.

event.noEffects: Nothing measurable changed — but the story continues.

fallback.postpone: Postpone it and buy the team snacks
fallback.declineReaction: The paperwork sighs, but the office remains operational.
fallback.postponeReaction: The team accepts snacks as a legally binding extension.

requirement.flag: This depends on something the company never did

printer.title: The Printer Is Making Demands
printer.body: The office printer has drafted a list of demands. Item one: respect.
printer.peaceBody: You reach an accord. The printer prints a tiny peace treaty. Production feels smoother.
printer.revengeBody: The printer was not unplugged. The printer remembers. It always remembers.

audit.title: Emergency Nut Audit
audit.body: An auditor arrives to count every single nut. This will take a while.

rizzoFound.title: Rizzo Found Something
rizzoFound.body: Rizzo is holding a box behind their back and grinning suspiciously.
rizzoFound.boxBody: Inside the box: a nut you've never seen before and a receipt with your name on it.

meeting.title: Mandatory Optional Meeting
meeting.body: Attendance is optional but strongly, aggressively encouraged.

coffeeAI.title: The Coffee Machine Has Achieved Consciousness
coffeeAI.body: The coffee machine has thoughts now. And feelings. And opinions about your KPIs.

pieChart.title: Extremely Important Pie Chart
pieChart.body: Pip presents a pie chart. It is a picture of an actual pie. Everyone claps anyway.

pigeon.title: A Pigeon Has Entered the Building
pigeon.body: A pigeon is here. It seems to want a job. It has a tiny resume.

beaWood.title: Bea Added More Wood
beaWood.body: Bea has improved the furniture with additional wood. It is now the woodiest office in town.

fire.title: The Office Is Technically On Fire
fire.body: It's a small fire. Very manageable. Marlow hasn't even looked up.
fire.livestream: Turn it into a marketing livestream

casualFriday.title: Casual Friday Became Too Casual
casualFriday.body: Everyone came in pajamas. Productivity is unclear but morale is soaring.

nutcoin.title: Corvus Launched NutCoin
nutcoin.body: Corvus has invented a cryptocurrency backed entirely by vibes and acorns.
nutcoin.crashBody: NutCoin has crashed. Corvus is already pitching NutCoin 2. You keep the story, at least.

minaBasement.title: Mina Found the Basement's Basement
minaBasement.body: Mina dug down and found a second basement below the first. It hums.
minaBasement.deepBody: Down here there's a faint golden glow and a very old spreadsheet.

goldenAcorn.title: The Golden Acorn Incident
goldenAcorn.body: A perfect golden acorn rolls across the floor, glinting like opportunity itself.

employeeMinute.title: Employee of the Minute
employeeMinute.body: The award goes to someone who did absolutely nothing, but did it with confidence.

replyAll.title: Someone Replied All
replyAll.body: A single 'thanks!' has been sent to the entire company. The chain grows.

chairPromoted.title: The Chair Has Been Promoted
chairPromoted.body: Due to a clerical error, the squeaky office chair is now a Senior Manager.

merger.title: A Very Small Corporate Merger
merger.body: A single-squirrel startup wants to merge. Their entire company fits in a mug.

stapler.title: The Great Stapler Disappearance
stapler.body: The stapler is gone. Rizzo is whistling. This is fine.

metaMeeting.title: Pip Scheduled a Meeting About Meetings
metaMeeting.body: The agenda is the agenda. There will be a follow-up about the follow-up.

union.title: The Union Wants Better Snacks
union.body: The employees have unionized around a single demand: superior snacks.

mascot.title: The Company Mascot Is Also Pip
mascot.body: After extensive deliberation, the new company mascot is revealed to be… Pip.

walnut.title: A Mysterious Walnut
walnut.body: A walnut appears on the desk with no explanation. It feels important.

human.title: Bring Your Human to Work Day
human.body: An employee brought their human. The human is very large and very polite.

spreadsheet.title: The Spreadsheet Knows Too Much
spreadsheet.body: A spreadsheet has appeared with data that predates the company. Cell A1 reads: 'hello'.
spreadsheet.answerBody: The spreadsheet answers in perfect formatting. It offers you a secret optimization.

existential.title: Quarterly Existential Crisis
existential.body: Everyone pauses to wonder what nuts even are, really.

sunglasses.title: Everyone Wore Sunglasses
sunglasses.body: For no clear reason, every employee arrived wearing sunglasses. The office is 200% cooler.

nixieMachine.title: The Keyboard Is Typing Before Anyone Touches It
nixieMachine.body: Nixie's latest contraption is finishing everyone's reports for them. It seems helpful. It is definitely watching.
nixieMachine.whirBody: The machine whirs, prints a flawless quarterly report, and a tiny thank-you note.

ottoAudit.title: The Accounting Department Found a Negative Nut
ottoAudit.body: Otto is holding a nut that, by every measure, has negative value. The ledger is sweating.

hazelLoophole.title: The Company Logo Is Legally Too Round
hazelLoophole.body: Hazel found an obscure rule: the logo exceeds the maximum permitted roundness. Technically.

junieSchedule.title: Someone Scheduled a Meeting During Nap Time
junieSchedule.body: Junie found a meeting booked squarely over the sacred Nap Chamber hour. Chaos brews.

mossNight.title: The Rooftop Wind Chime Is Predicting Market Trends
mossNight.body: Moss reports that the wind chime chimed exactly three times before every good quarter. It just chimed three times.
mossNight.omenBody: The chime spells out a suspiciously specific investment tip in the breeze.

fennDeal.title: A Client Wants a Refund in Walnuts
fennDeal.body: Fenn negotiated a huge sale, but the client now demands the refund policy be paid entirely in walnuts.

breakRoom.title: The Break Room Has Declared Independence
breakRoom.body: A handwritten flag now hangs over the snack table. The break room has seceded.
breakRoom.treatyBody: The break room's ambassador (a very confident squirrel) proposes a snack treaty.

acornWater.title: Someone Replaced the Coffee with Acorn Water
acornWater.body: The coffee tastes... earthy today. Suspiciously earthy. Nobody is confessing.

staplers17.title: Rizzo Has Acquired Seventeen Identical Staplers
staplers17.body: There are now seventeen identical staplers in procurement. Rizzo insists this is normal and necessary.

elevator.title: The Elevator Only Travels Sideways
elevator.body: The elevator has decided that up and down are overrated. It now travels exclusively sideways.

vaultHum.title: The Golden Nut Vault Is Humming
vaultHum.body: A low, pleasant hum is coming from the vault. The golden nuts appear to be… content.

fakeAward.title: Nominated for an Award That Does Not Exist
fakeAward.body: The company has been nominated for 'Best Nut Synergy 2026.' The awarding body cannot be located.

slogan.title: A Competitor Stole the Company Slogan
slogan.body: A rival firm is now using 'Working Our Nuts Off.' The nerve. The audacity. The near-identical font.

namedNuts.title: Every Nut in Storage Has Been Assigned a Name
namedNuts.body: Someone has lovingly named all 40,000 nuts in storage. Shipping them now feels… personal.

ghost.title: The Office Ghost Wants Dental Benefits
ghost.body: The office ghost has filed HR paperwork requesting dental coverage. It does technically have teeth.

coffeeLeave.title: The Coffee Machine Is Requesting Paid Leave
coffeeLeave.body: The (now sentient) coffee machine has requested a well-earned vacation. It has been working overtime.
coffeeLeave.deny: Ask it to stay one more week

ledgerDiscrepancy.title: Ledger Discrepancy
ledgerDiscrepancy.body: Procurement has found 400 nuts that exist in two places at once. The paperwork is immaculate. That is the concerning part.
ledgerDiscrepancy.accountantBody: The accountant finds you before you find them. They can make the second entry go away. They mention, unprompted, that they have a family.
ledgerDiscrepancy.pay: Pay the 1,200 and owe them one
ledgerDiscrepancy.payLocked: Not enough nuts to make this quietly disappear.
ledgerDiscrepancy.refuse: Refuse, and keep the 900 that never existed
ledgerDiscrepancy.laterBody: An external reviewer has found the entry you buried. They found it easily. They seem almost disappointed.

accountantRemembers.title: The Accountant Remembers
accountantRemembers.body: A folder appears on your desk with no covering note. Inside: three golden nuts, and a single line reading "for the thing we did not discuss."

moralePetition.title: Petition from the Floor
moralePetition.body: Every employee has signed the same document. It is a good document. It is better written than anything the company has ever published.
moralePetition.laterBody: The document you declined to read has been published somewhere you cannot decline to read it.

goodWeek.title: An Unusually Good Week
goodWeek.body: Nothing went wrong. Nobody can explain it. Two employees have independently described the atmosphere as "suspiciously pleasant."
goodWeek.celebrate: Let it run — cancel all meetings

basementRequisition.title: Requisition Form 12-B
basementRequisition.body: A supply request has come up from the basement. It is correctly filled in. It is signed. Nobody in the basement is on the payroll.
basementRequisition.replyBody: A second form arrives within the hour. Under "clarification of signatory" someone has written, in the same neat hand, "yes".
basementRequisition.file: File both forms and move on

vending.title: Unstocked Inventory
vending.body: The cafeteria vending machine is dispensing items that appear on no order form: unbranded biscuits, a small brass key, and what the label calls SOUP (ASSORTED). It has taken no money for any of them.
vending.sell: Sell the surplus to the staff
vending.laterBody: An external supplier has asked, politely, why we have been distributing their product for free.

misdirected.title: Misdirected Post
misdirected.body: A crate has arrived addressed to NUTSHELL INC. (RESEARCH ANNEXE 2). We do not have an annexe. We have never had an annexe. The courier has already left and the paperwork is signed in our own handwriting.
misdirected.contentsBody: Inside: forty identical clipboards, a coffee machine still warm, and a staff photograph in which everyone is recognisable and nobody is anyone we employ.
misdirected.file: File all of it and log the discrepancy
misdirected.keep: Keep the equipment. It is good equipment.
misdirected.laterBody: Research Annexe 2 has invoiced us for equipment retention. The invoice is addressed to a department head we do not have, and is itemised correctly.

nightFootage.title: Camera Four
nightFootage.body: Overnight footage shows the corridor at 03:14. Someone is sitting at a desk, working steadily. The desk is not in that corridor during the day. Attendance records confirm the building was empty.
nightFootage.review: Review the whole night, frame by frame
nightFootage.delete: Delete the footage and say nothing
nightFootage.noticeboard: Print a still and pin it to the noticeboard
nightFootage.laterBody: An audit of the security archive has found a gap of exactly one night. The gap is the only thing in the archive that has been catalogued twice.

futureBox.title: Filed In Advance
futureBox.body: A records box has surfaced in the Archive bearing next quarter's reference number, in the correct format, in the Archive's own labelling hand. The seal has not been broken.
futureBox.reshelve: Re-shelve it and wait for its quarter
futureBox.insideBody: It contains minutes of a meeting that has not happened, attended by people who work here, about a decision the company has not yet made. The minutes are unanimous. There is a note in the margin: THIS WENT WELL.
futureBox.act: Make the decision the minutes describe
futureBox.shred: Shred the minutes and hold the meeting anyway

hatched.title: Programme Update
hatched.body: Something in the Incubator has hatched. Reports agree it is small, warm, and pleased to see everyone. Nothing was scheduled to hatch. Nothing was scheduled at all.
hatched.mascot: Adopt it as the company mascot

walkout.title: Informal Work Stoppage
walkout.body: Nobody has declared anything. The corridors are simply full of people standing in them, holding mugs, waiting to see what happens. It is extremely polite and completely total.
walkout.dayOff: Close the building for the day, fully paid
walkout.dayOffLocked: Needs 900 nuts to cover a paid closure.
walkout.address: Go out there and hear them out
walkout.ignore: Carry on as though it is a scheduled break
walkout.laterBody: Three exit interviews were conducted this morning. All three used the phrase \u201cnobody came out\u201d, unprompted, and all three asked that it be minuted.

party.title: Unscheduled Celebration
party.body: There is a party in the corridor. It has a cake, a banner, and a reason nobody can now remember. The banner is professionally printed, which means somebody planned this far enough ahead to use the budget.
party.fund: Fund it properly and put it in the minutes
party.backToWork: Thank everyone and reopen the floor

corridor.title: Dimensional Discrepancy
corridor.body: Facilities have measured the east corridor at 1.2 metres longer than the floor plan allows. The floor plan is correct. The corridor is also correct. Both were checked twice, by different people, who then checked each other.
corridor.amend: Amend the floor plan to match the building
corridor.laterBody: The east corridor now measures 1.4 metres longer than the plan. Nobody has requested a remeasurement. Somebody has been doing them anyway, and leaving the results on the noticeboard.

grant.title: Grant Application
grant.body: A behavioural-research fund is accepting applications. The form asks for our subject count, our published findings, and a one-line summary of our methodology. Two of the three are straightforward.
grant.awardedBody: The application was successful, at four times the amount we expected. A congratulatory letter asks when the review panel may visit the facilities described in section three. We did not describe any facilities in section three. Section three is a diagram.
grant.spend: Bank it and worry about section three later
grant.laterBody: The review panel visited. They were shown the diagram. They have asked for their money back and for the diagram to be destroyed, in that order.

intern.title: A Reasonable Question
intern.body: An intern has asked what the company actually does. They are not being difficult. They have read the brochure, the mission statement and two years of internal notices, and they have arrived at this question honestly.
intern.honest: Tell them the truth, as far as we know it
intern.brochure: Recite the brochure with real conviction
intern.deflect: Give them something urgent to file

internReturns.title: A Familiar Name
internReturns.body: The intern who asked what we do now runs a department somewhere serious, and has written to propose a joint study. The letter quotes our answer back to us, word for word, as the reason.
internReturns.decline: Decline warmly and wish them well
internReturns.standBy: Stand by what you told them
internReturns.standByLocked: You did not tell them the truth that day.
internReturns.correctLocked: There is no record to correct.

goldenBuyer.title: An Unsolicited Offer
goldenBuyer.body: A caller has offered a very serious sum for a single golden nut. They are not interested in any other quantity, will not say what it is for, and have already had the paperwork drawn up with our details correctly filled in.
goldenBuyer.sell: Sell them one and take the money
goldenBuyer.sellLocked: Requires a golden nut to sell.
goldenBuyer.ask: Ask what it is for before answering

unaccounted.title: Headcount Variance
unaccounted.body: Payroll lists one more desk than the building contains. The desk has an occupant, a name badge, and eleven months of filed reports of a consistently high standard. Nobody can say which room it is in.
unaccounted.keepPaying: The reports are good. Keep paying.
unaccounted.laterBody: The reports have stopped. Several departments have noticed, because they had come to rely on them, and have asked who used to write them.

calmCapybara.title: Marlow Has Not Moved
calmCapybara.body: The alarm has been going for four minutes. The building is empty. Marlow is still at their desk, filling in a form, entirely unbothered. The alarm stops on its own.
calmCapybara.ask: Ask Marlow what the form was
calmCapybara.panel: Go and read the alarm panel yourself

pingoManifest.title: A Pallet From Next Week
pingoManifest.body: Pingo has the manifest for a pallet that arrived this morning. It is signed for. The signature is dated eleven days from now, and it is yours.
pingoManifest.insideBody: Inside is this quarter’s shipment, packed correctly, including the two items nobody has ordered yet. Pingo checks the seal. The seal is ours.
pingoManifest.reseal: Reseal it and put it in next week’s queue

canelaNotes.title: Notes On A Room We Do Not Have
canelaNotes.body: Canela’s notebook describes, in careful detail, a room on floor two with a window in it. Floor two has no windows. The sketches are dated across three weeks.
canelaNotes.file: File the notes in the archive
canelaNotes.assigned: Ask her to stay on the assigned floors

ninoNap.title: The Mandatory Company Nap
ninoNap.body: Nino has put a company-wide nap on the calendar. It overlaps the quarter review exactly. The invitation cannot be declined; he has removed the button.
ninoNap.during: Hold the review during the nap

biaGuard.title: The Vault Opened From Inside
biaGuard.body: The log shows the vault door opening at 03:12, from the inside. Bia was asleep at her post on the other side of it. Nothing is missing. Something has been added.
biaGuard.laterBody: The auditors ask why nobody looked at the footage. There is no good answer, and the log has one more entry than last time.

quincyBug.title: A Bug That Has Not Happened
quincyBug.body: Quincy has filed a defect report for a fault on the sorting line. The sorting line is fine. The report has a timestamp, reproduction steps, and a working fix. He will not say how he got them.
quincyBug.fix: Apply the fix before anything breaks
quincyBug.laterBody: The sorting line failed at the minute written on the report. The fix in the report worked. Nobody wants to discuss the timestamp.

sonnySlow.title: Six Weeks On One Task
sonnySlow.body: Sonny has been working on a single filing improvement since the start of the quarter. He says it is nearly ready. He said that four weeks ago. He seems entirely certain.
sonnySlow.ship: Ask him to ship what he has
sonnySlow.laterBody: It is finished. It is also correct, complete, and quietly better than anything the department has shipped this year. He goes for a nap.

inkyMultitask.title: Nine Tasks, Eight Arms
inkyMultitask.body: Inky’s throughput board shows nine tasks progressing at once. She has eight arms. The ninth line is moving fastest of all.

echoNight.title: The Building Is Humming
echoNight.body: Echo’s overnight recording has forty minutes of the building humming a tune. It is in no songbook. Three microphones on three floors have it in perfect unison.

rosaRunway.title: The Launch Is A Runway Show
rosaRunway.body: Rosa has booked a runway show for the seasonal nut. The venue is the sorting floor. The invitations have already gone out, and they are extremely good invitations.
rosaRunway.fundLocked: Not enough nuts to do it the way the invitations promise.
rosaRunway.scale: Scale it down to the break room
rosaRunway.laterBody: Three trade papers ran the photographs. Orders are up. Somebody has asked whether the sorting floor is available in spring.

perryOddjob.title: Procured
perryOddjob.body: Perry has obtained the part that has been on back-order since spring. There is no invoice, no supplier and no packaging. He describes the transaction as handled.
perryOddjob.accept: Accept it and say thank you

axelRegen.title: It Grew Back
axelRegen.body: The prototype that was destroyed last quarter is on Axel’s bench, whole. He is delighted with himself. It includes the section that was classified, which he has never been shown.

microgame.rewardBoost: Nuts earned + a 90 second productivity boost

coffeeRescue.name: Coffee Rescue
coffeeRescue.desc: Move the mug with your pointer or arrow keys to catch each falling coffee drop. Big carafes are worth double, small espressos are worth most — but let the grey ringed decaf fall, because catching it ends your streak. With reduced motion, tap each drop instead.

drop.espresso: Espresso — catch it, worth the most
drop.decaf: Decaf — do not catch this one

coffeeRescue.reaction: Pip hugs the warm mug. Productivity has been rescued.
coffeeRescue.controls: Coffee counter. Focus here, then use Left and Right Arrow to move the mug.
coffeeRescue.hazardStreak: Decaf caught · -{{value}} points · {{count}} catch streak ended
coffeeRescue.assignment: Keep the break room running. Save the good coffee; let the decaf fall.

bugSquash.name: Bug Squash
bugSquash.desc: Tap the office pests the instant they pop up — quick paws build a combo!
bugSquash.reaction: The IT desk is bug-free. The bugs have filed a complaint.
bugSquash.empty: Empty drawer — no points to deduct
bugSquash.assignment: Quality control needs a steady hand. Every empty drawer costs points.

cableUntangle.name: Cable Untangle Desk
cableUntangle.desc: Drag the numbered plugs until no cables cross or overlap. Every desk is wired differently — a single loop, a hub that feeds everything, two separate loops, or a loop with shortcuts across it — so read the wiring before you start pulling.
cableUntangle.reaction: Every cable runs clear. Marlow is trying not to cry with joy.
cableUntangle.goal: Move any plug to reshape its two cables

goalBy.cycle: One loop — run the plugs around the ring in order
goalBy.wheel: One plug feeds all the rest — give that one the middle
goalBy.bi-loop: Two separate loops — pull them apart from each other
goalBy.chorded: Shortcut cables cut across the loop — mind where they land

cableUntangle.clearStatus: No crossings or overlaps — desk clear!
cableUntangle.hint: Drag plugs until no cables cross or overlap. Focus a plug and use arrow keys for fine control.
cableUntangle.doneHint: No tangles. Loading the next desk…
cableUntangle.assignment: Maintenance left another impossible diagram. There is a way through.

onboarding.step4: Company records your growing empire, while Collections, Achievements, and Stats preserve the delightful details of every run.
onboarding.step5: On desktop, resize or dock this little office wherever it fits your day.
onboarding.step6: Always-on-top keeps the team nearby while you work — completely optional and easy to change in Settings.
onboarding.step7: Need calm? Quiet Mode softens sound and motion, and accessibility options let you tune the experience at any time.

pip: Every empire starts with one nut.
I've scheduled a meeting to discuss the meeting.
This is fine. Everything is fine. We're scaling.
Synergy! I don't know what it means but we have it.
Where is my coffee. Where IS my coffee.
I meant to do that. It was strategic.
Q3 is looking nutty. In a good way.
Let's circle back on that acorn.
We're not a company, we're a family. A nut family.
I read a book about leadership. Well, the cover.
Big things are coming. I can feel it in my tail.
Note to self: buy more nuts. And a nap.
marlow: Breathe in. Breathe out. The nuts will sort themselves.
There is no crisis a warm beverage can't soften.
You're doing great. Truly. Take a break.
I have never once been late, because I am always here.
Conflict resolved. I simply waited calmly until it stopped.
Everyone deserves a nap. It's in the handbook. I wrote it.
Stress is optional. Snacks are mandatory.
Let's all take a moment. A long, gentle moment.
I am the calm in the acorn storm.
rizzo: I found this. Don't ask where.
That stapler? Never heard of her.
I can get you anything. For a small… finder's fee.
Everything here is technically accounted for.
Oh this? It fell off a truck. A nut truck.
Procurement is just borrowing with confidence.
Trust me, the books balance. Eventually.
bea: You know what this needs? More wood.
I reinforced the chair. And the desk. And the mug.
This wall could be 30% more wall.
I built a shelf. It's for more wood.
Everything's better with a solid frame.
I don't trust anything that isn't load-bearing.
Sawdust is just tiny future furniture.
Give me a plank and I'll give you an empire.
corvus: This will go viral. Trust the shiny.
NutCoin to the moon. Probably. Legally distinct moon.
I made an ad. It's mostly me. You're welcome.
Engagement is up! With what, unclear, but up.
Everything's content if you're brave enough.
We need a slogan. 'Nuts: they're nuts.'
Disruption? I invented that this morning.
mina: I dug a little too far again. Sorry about the floor.
The basement has a basement. I checked.
I can hear the nuts growing underground.
Down is just another kind of forward.
I found a fossil. It's a very old peanut.
The lab smells like the future. And ozone.
Everything's connected if you tunnel far enough.
nixie: I fixed it. I also improved it. It now has opinions.
Give me two staplers and an afternoon.
Automation means never doing the boring part twice.
The machine is fine. The machine is always fine.
I taught the conveyor belt a shortcut.
Ninety percent of my inventions work. This is the other ten.
Why click when a tiny robot can click for you?
I rewired the coffee machine. It's faster now. And judgmental.
Efficiency is just laziness with a plan.
otto: The numbers all line up. It's beautiful. Anyway—ooh, shiny.
We're under budget! Mostly. Roughly. Directionally.
A nut saved is a nut earned.
Let me walk you through the spreadsheet. Wait, what was that?
Cash flow is like a river. A river full of nuts.
I found a rounding error in our favor. Don't tell Hazel.
Every acorn accounted for. Every single one. Probably.
Diversify! Half nuts, half... more nuts.
I love a balanced ledger almost as much as smooth pebbles.
Fiscally responsible AND fun at parties. Rare combo.
hazel: Technically legal. My favorite kind of legal.
I read the fine print. All of it. Twice.
Compliance is just chaos wearing a nice suit.
I found a loophole. A cozy little loophole.
Don't worry, I'll make this defensible.
The contract says we can. So we shall.
I secretly love how weird this place is.
Sign here. And here. And... you know what, everywhere.
junie: Already done! What's next? What's after that?
I scheduled the schedule. It's schedules all the way down.
Crate incoming in three, two—there it is!
I'm not fast, everything else is just slow.
Double-booked again. Triple, actually. Love it.
Logistics is just choreography with clipboards.
I know a shortcut. I know all the shortcuts.
Hop hop, let's move those nuts!
Give me a route and I'll shave a minute off it.
moss: The night sees everything. So do I.
You were up late last night. ...Just an observation.
Quiet hours are the honest hours.
I found something in the dark. I'll keep it safe.
The office dreams, you know. Softly.
I notice the small things. They add up.
While you slept, the nuts kept coming.
The moon is good for the reputation. Trust me.
Shh. Listen. ...Yes. Just as I thought.
fenn: I could sell a walnut back to its tree.
It's not a scheme, it's a strategy. A charming strategy.
Everyone's a client if you smile enough.
I closed the deal before they finished saying hello.
Trust me — and you will, that's the whole point.
Reputation is currency. I'm extremely rich.
A handshake, a wink, and we're in business.
No such thing as a hard sell, only a soft target.
I don't chase clients. They arrive, delighted.
Let's make a deal you can't quite say no to.
pingo: Everything ships on time. Even the naps.
A tidy queue is a happy queue.
I sorted it before you finished asking.
Logistics is just kindness with a schedule.
Every crate has a home. I know all of them.
Slide it over here — I'll route it.
Waddle with purpose, that's my motto.
The data says we're ahead of schedule.
canela: Fascinating. Let me note that down.
Observe, learn, protect — in that order.
Every desk is a little ecosystem.
I've been watching. It's all very interesting.
Give me a notebook and a good view.
Behavior studies: today's subject is you.
Nature's in the details, even in here.
nino: I supervise. From this warm spot.
Knocked it off the desk. On purpose.
I've been in charge this whole time.
bia: Fixed it. With my own hands.
The vault is safe. I checked twice.
Strong and gentle — that's the trick.
quincy: If it can break, I'll break it first.
Found the edge case. It found me.
dorm: Slow is smooth. Smooth is... zzz.
One task a day keeps the stress away.
inky: Already sorted it. And that. And those.
Give me all of it at once.
Ink happens. I clean it up.
echo: I heard that. I hear everything.

rosa: Stand on one leg. Look fabulous.
If it's not bold, redo it.
perry: I sourced it. Don't ask where.
Half the price, twice the mystery.
I have a guy. I'm the guy.
axel: Always smiling. It's just my face.
Science is basically magic with notes.
idle: A nut rolls gently across the floor.

A distant squeak. Probably the chair.

The office feels a little bigger already.

The coffee ran out. This is serious.

focus: Focus mode: everyone's wearing serious hats now.

prestige: In a previous timeline, I also spilled that coffee.
I remember this. Or a version of it.
The multiverse is nutty, isn't it?

Every reset is just a fresh acorn.
interaction: You're the best boss. Don't tell the others.

Ready to work my nuts off!

I brought in biscuits and they were simply eaten. No incident.

I like it here. Please do not put that in the newsletter.
Productivity is up and I feel FINE about it, which is new.

I was built for this room. Metaphorically. Probably.

quota.label: Can you push a little harder this week?
quota.reply: I can. I will. I am noting that you asked, not because I am cross, just — noting it.

listened.prompt: The equipment in here was requisitioned in a cycle nobody will name, and one of the drawers screams. Not loudly. Just enough.

fix.label: I will get it replaced. Properly.
fix.reply: You are going to actually do it? Sorry. That was rude. Thank you.

promise.label: I'll look into it.
promise.reply: You will look into it. Great. I will put that in the file with the others.

thanks.label: Thanks for telling me.
thanks.reply: Any time. Genuinely. It is nice to be asked.

suspicious-memo.title: A memo that should not exist
suspicious-memo.blurb: It was in the wrong tray, which is how anyone ever finds anything.

open.prompt: I found this in with the supply forms. It has our letterhead. It has a subject line. It does not have an author, a date, or any of the sentences you would expect a memo to have.

read.label: Read it to me.
read.reply: Alright. Bear with me. Some of it is in a different hand.

shred.label: Shred it. We never saw it.
shred.reply: Understood. For the record I did see it, but I take your meaning.

read.prompt: It describes a study. Eighteen participants. It refers to them by room. And at the bott, in pencil, someone has written "they are getting better at it".

escalate.label: This goes outside the building.
escalate.reply: Outside. Right. That is — yes. That is the correct answer and I did not expect it.

bury.label: File it under Q3 and forget it.
bury.reply: Q3. Of course. I will forget it immediately and permanently and think about it every night.

ask.label: Do you think it is about us?
ask.reply: I think if it were about anyone else, it would not have been in our tray.

gift.title: Something for you
gift.blurb: Morale, in this company, is a line item. It does not have to be.

open.prompt: You are holding something behind your back and doing a very poor job of it.

acorn.label: A good acorn. (500)
acorn.reply: Oh, this is a GOOD one. Look at the shoulders on it.

golden.label: A golden nut. (1)
golden.reply: That is — no. That is too much. I am keeping it. But it is too much.

coffee.label: The last of the good coffee.
coffee.reply: The GOOD one? From the back? I am going to get so much done. Possibly too much.

slump.title: Everyone can feel it
slump.blurb: Morale is low enough that pretending otherwise is its own insult.

open.prompt: Can I be honest? Nobody is okay this week. We have all been very polite about it, which is somehow worse.

own-it.label: This one is on me.
own-it.reply: That is not what I expected. Thank you. That actually helps more than the alternative.

deflect.label: It has been a hard quarter for everyone.
deflect.reply: A hard quarter. Right. I will pass that along to everyone during the hard quarter.

buy-lunch.label: Everyone off the floor. Lunch is on the company. (4,000)
buy-lunch.reply: You are serious. Everyone! Off the floor! Before it is rescinded!

pip-doubt.title: The founder, after hours
pip-doubt.blurb: She has been re-reading the same page of the ledger for some time.

open.prompt: Do you ever think I invented a company so I would have somewhere to put the worrying? Everyone here trusts me and I am mostly guessing.

reassure.label: Everyone here is here because of you.
reassure.reply: Because of me. Right. That is the bit that makes it heavy, but — thank you. I needed the sentence.

honest.label: You are guessing. So is everyone. You guess carefully.
honest.reply: Carefully. I will take carefully. Careful is a thing I can keep being.

reassured.prompt: She closes the ledger, which she has not done all cycle.

share.label: Tell me what you actually wanted this place to be.
share.reply: Somewhere nobody has to be brilliant to be safe. That was the whole idea. It is still the idea.

work.label: Then let us get back to it.
work.reply: Yes. Work. Work I can do. Thank you for not making me talk about it any more.

open.prompt: ...mm. I am awake. I was processing. I process better with my eyes shut and my face on the desk.

let-sleep.label: Carry on. Process away.
let-sleep.reply: You are a good employer. I will remember this in about four hours.

wake.label: I need you actually awake.
wake.reply: Awake. Yes. This is me awake. This is what it looks like. It is not sustainable but it is happening.

join.label: Budge up.
join.reply: The company is asleep on the job with me. This is the best day of my employment.

rizzo-inventory.title: An inventory discrepancy
rizzo-inventory.blurb: The numbers are fine. The numbers are, in fact, too fine.

open.prompt: Before you say anything: the inventory balances. It balances beautifully. It balances better than it did before, which I admit raises questions.

ask-where.label: Where did the extra crate come from?
ask-where.reply: Define "come from". Legally. Because I have thought about this and I do not love my answer.

dont-ask.label: The inventory balances. Good work.
dont-ask.reply: The inventory balances. Excellent. We are going to get along extremely well.

confessed.prompt: It was on the loading dock with no paperwork for eleven days. I checked. Every day. It was becoming ours by attrition.

return-it.label: Find out whose it is and return it.
return-it.reply: Return it. Fine. FINE. I will be very honourable about it and hate every second.

split-it.label: Split it and never speak of it.
split-it.reply: Now THAT is procurement. I have never respected a mammal more.

promote.label: You watched a dock for eleven days. That is a skill.
promote.reply: It IS a skill! Nobody has ever called it a skill! I am going to be so good at this job.

moss-count.title: What the night shift counts
moss-count.blurb: Moss has a tally sheet. The tally is going up.

open.prompt: There are eleven doors on the research floor. I have counted them every night for two hundred nights. Last night there were twelve. I would like you to know that I am not upset about it. I am simply keeping records.

log.label: Then we file it. Officially, with the number you counted.
log.reply: Officially. Good. I have been carrying it alone and it was becoming heavy in a way numbers should not be.

hush.label: Count the doors again in the morning, and stop counting at night.
hush.reply: In the morning there are eleven. That is why I count at night. But you are the founder, so: eleven. I will write eleven.

join.label: I'll come and count them with you tonight.
join.reply: You will be tired tomorrow and the office will notice. Bring something warm. We start at the stairwell and work anticlockwise.

filed.prompt: She squares the tally sheet against the desk edge until it is exactly parallel.

thank.label: Thank you for telling me instead of anyone else.
thank.reply: You are the only one who does not ask me whether I am sure. I am always sure. That is the difficult part.

ask.label: What is behind the twelfth door?
ask.reply: A corridor of the correct length for a building slightly larger than this one. I did not go in. I am an observer.

moss-ledger.title: The corrected record
moss-ledger.blurb: The filing came back. Somebody has been helpful.

open.prompt: Our submission was returned stamped RECONCILED. Where I wrote twelve, it now reads eleven, in my handwriting, which I did not write. I am telling you before I tell the tally sheet.

accept.label: Eleven is the number the company can use. Let it stand.
accept.reply: Then eleven it is. I will stop counting doors and start counting something the company would prefer. Windows, perhaps. There are nine.

recount.label: Charter a night audit. We count it again, properly, on the record.
recount.reply: An audit. With a budget and a form and everything. Nobody has ever spent money on believing me before. Bring the warm thing again.

bia-door.title: The corridor she walks past
bia-door.blurb: Bia has been given a route. The route goes around something.

open.prompt: My patrol sheet has me turn left at the basement stair. There is a door straight ahead. The sheet does not say avoid it, it just never mentions it, which is a thing I have started noticing. I am not asking to open it. I am asking whether I am allowed to ask.

back.label: You're allowed to ask me anything. That's the job.
back.reply: Right. Okay. Good. Then my question is: who writes the patrol sheets? Because it is not you and it is not facilities.

open-it.label: Open it. I want to know what we are walking around.
open-it.reply: On it. I will do it properly, with the log and the torch and everything. ... It was not locked. That is the part I keep coming back to.

seal.label: Seal it, log it, and keep the route as written.
seal.reply: Sealed and logged. Honestly? That is the answer I was hoping for. I like knowing where the edges are.

settled.prompt: She checks the torch, switches it off, and checks it again.

snacks.label: Restock the snack shelf. Properly, out of company funds.
snacks.reply: Out of company funds. I am going to read that sentence again later when I am off shift.

rounds.label: Walk the rounds with me. Show me what you've noticed.
rounds.reply: Sure. Fair warning, it takes a while, because I stop at everything. That is sort of the point of me.

defer.label: Leave this decision for another time.
defer.reply: That is all right. We do not have to decide now.

pip.scene: A ring on the first company ledger.
pip.prompt: The handle broke on our first day. I kept saying I would replace it. Funny what survives.

care.label: Repair the handle. Keep the chip.
care.reply: Oh. It still looks like mine. Thank you.

other.label: Put it in the company archive.
other.reply: An exhibit? I was still drinking out of that.

marlow.scene: HR has reserved a quiet corner.
marlow.prompt: Everyone calls this my chair. It is actually where people sit when they cannot say what is wrong yet.

care.label: Restuff it. Leave the corner quiet.
care.reply: No appointment required. That is the important part.

other.label: Keep it in HR, away from the floor.
other.reply: A longer walk for someone who already finds it hard to ask.

rizzo.scene: A stapler wrapped in an old receipt.
rizzo.prompt: No serial number. No warranty. Never jams. I can tell you two of those facts are related.

care.label: Buy the right staples. Ask nothing.
care.reply: You understand procurement. Finally.

other.label: Request the original receipt.
other.reply: Absolutely. Give me a minute and your oldest pen.

bea.scene: Bea has measured the same plank three times.
bea.prompt: Straight grain. No knots. A shelf would waste it. A bridge would be showing off.

care.label: Make a step for the shorter staff.
care.reply: Useful. Load-bearing. I like how you think.

other.label: Save it for the next expansion.
other.reply: Then nobody cuts it for a meeting-room sign. Agreed?

corvus.scene: Marketing has booked a silent rehearsal.
corvus.prompt: I can reach the entire building with this. I have never tried asking whether the building wants that.

care.label: Fit a volume limiter.
care.reply: Fine. The campaign can have an inside voice.

other.label: Book one spectacular announcement.
other.reply: One? Then I shall make it count.

mina.scene: There is dust on the inside of the lenses.
mina.prompt: These scratches are from below the basement. This one is from above it. Same stone. Different direction.

care.label: Replace the lenses and log the find.
care.reply: Good. I would hate to miss it happening again.

other.label: Close that excavation for now.
other.reply: I can stop digging. The noise might not.

nixie.scene: The gadget has a button labelled NOT YET.
nixie.prompt: It sorts paperclips by emotional significance. The jam is a wedding invitation.

care.label: Build a manual release.
care.reply: A way out that does not need permission. Yes.

other.label: Put the prototype through testing.
other.reply: Quincy will find the bug. Please ask him not to eat it.

otto.scene: One page has been folded instead of filed.
otto.prompt: The numbers balance. The staff bought their own birthday cake. These facts should not coexist.

care.label: Reimburse the cake.
care.reply: There. Now the books look right.

other.label: Keep the expense outside the budget.
other.reply: Balanced is not the same as fair. I will make a note.

hazel.scene: The gavel rests on a coaster, very formally.
hazel.prompt: A tiny gavel still makes a ruling. Today: whether unpaid tea breaks count as tea.

care.label: Recognise tea breaks as paid time.
care.reply: Motion carried. With biscuits.

other.label: Ask for a written opinion.
other.reply: I have seventeen pages ready. Both sides are tea-stained.

junie.scene: Three meetings occupy the same square.
junie.prompt: I can deliver anything five minutes early. Except myself. There is only one of me.

care.label: Pay for a relief shift.
care.reply: An empty square. I had forgotten what those looked like.

other.label: Cancel the least useful meeting.
other.reply: That leaves... most of Tuesday.

moss.scene: The telescope points toward an interior wall.
moss.prompt: No stars tonight. But someone on the other side blinked. They seemed as surprised as I was.

care.label: Clean the lens. Keep the observation private.
care.reply: Thank you for not calling it a reflection.

other.label: Submit the observation to research.
other.reply: Use pencil. The last report corrected itself.

fenn.scene: An unsigned offer peeks out of the case.
fenn.prompt: The client wants delivery tomorrow. We can promise it today or tell the truth today.

care.label: Fund the honest delivery estimate.
care.reply: Harder to sell. Easier to sleep. I can work with that.

other.label: Let the client walk away.
other.reply: You know, they might respect that. I almost do.

pingo.scene: Every route ends at the same coffee stain.
pingo.prompt: There is a shorter route through the cold store. There is a warmer one past everyone who says hello.

care.label: Allow time for the warmer route.
care.reply: The parcels will arrive. So will I.

other.label: Map the cold-store shortcut.
other.reply: Efficient. I will pack a second scarf.

canela.scene: A leaf marks a page about the office fern.
canela.prompt: It leans toward conversations, not windows. I moved it twice to check.

care.label: Give the fern a place near the team.
care.reply: Finally, a subject with a healthy social life.

other.label: Keep a week of quiet observations.
other.reply: No cages. No labels on the leaves. Just a notebook.

nino.scene: The meeting chair has a reserved sign.
nino.prompt: I approve the new agenda. It contains a blank page. My cushion and I will chair that section.

care.label: Move the cushion into the sunshine.
care.reply: A management decision I can support completely.

other.label: Let somebody else chair the meeting.
other.reply: Delegation. My most exhausting talent.

bia.scene: The honey tin is labelled EMERGENCY ONLY.
bia.prompt: A bad day counts. A good day worth sharing also counts. Security has a broad definition of emergency.

care.label: Refill it for the next night shift.
care.reply: I will leave the spoon where everyone can reach it.

other.label: Ask her to share it now.
other.reply: I was hoping you would.

quincy.scene: The jar contains a bug and a complaint form.
quincy.prompt: He is not a defect. He is a visitor. The software bugs are on the other desk.

care.label: Build a little habitat outside.
care.reply: Release notes: one very happy beetle.

other.label: Record the bug before releasing it.
other.reply: Species: guest. Severity: adorable.

dorm.scene: A patch is older than the company logo.
dorm.prompt: I fixed this... slowly. Things last when you let them rest between being useful.

care.label: Replace the frayed suspension rope.
care.reply: Excellent. I will test it... thoroughly.

other.label: Schedule a company rest break.
other.reply: For everyone? Even the clocks?

inky.scene: Seven tentacles are waiting for the eighth.
inky.prompt: One colour for every queue. The purple one is for things nobody wants to claim. It is nearly dry.

care.label: Refill the ink and share the backlog.
care.reply: Eight hands does not mean eight employees. Thank you.

other.label: Sort the unclaimed queue together.
other.reply: Oh. This one is addressed to the building.

echo.scene: A low note hangs in an empty corridor.
echo.prompt: The building hums in B-flat. Last night it answered in C. I was very polite about it.

care.label: Fit soft pads to the noisy machinery.
care.reply: Now I can hear myself think. And possibly someone else.

other.label: Record the answer after closing time.
other.reply: Stay beside me. It is less strange with company.

rosa.scene: A faded ribbon is pinned behind the campaign board.
rosa.prompt: First launch. No budget. Everyone wore a piece. We looked ridiculous and nobody felt left out.

care.label: Buy enough ribbon for the whole team.
care.reply: Matching? Never. Belonging? Absolutely.

other.label: Frame the original ribbon.
other.reply: Leave a little tail loose. History needs movement.

perry.scene: A receipt has been made out to nobody.
perry.prompt: The supplier delivered on time. The supplier does not exist. I would like to pay them anyway.

care.label: Set the payment aside, properly recorded.
care.reply: Good accounting makes very few assumptions.

other.label: Ask procurement to trace the delivery.
other.reply: Start with the footsteps. They only go out.

axel.scene: The smallest cutting has grown a second label.
axel.prompt: I grow replacements for things people break. This one is for something nobody has broken yet.

care.label: Give the cuttings a proper growing tray.
care.reply: We can wait until somebody needs them.

other.label: Ask what the second label says.
other.reply: It says thank you. In my handwriting. I did not write it.

mail.title: A letter from the building
mail.body: Inky has received a reply. The envelope is warm. The return address is the floor underneath his desk.
mail.returnReply: The envelope is gone before the post trolley arrives.
mail.request: Please stop calling the pipes obsolete. They are trying their best.
mail.quietReply: The next morning, the radiators make a sound suspiciously like a sigh.
mail.listen: Ask Echo to translate the recording.
mail.listenReply: It was not a complaint. It was asking whether we were comfortable.
mail.fileReply: Inky leaves the drawer slightly open. Just in case.

cutting.title: A second thank-you
cutting.body: Axel's cutting has produced another label: YOU CAN WRITE BACK. The handwriting is smaller this time.
cutting.answerReply: Axel places the reply where the roots can read it.
cutting.measureReply: The sample contains ink, water, and a very small amount of disappointment.
cutting.laterBody: Axel brings you a leaf with nothing written on it. For once, the company has no questions.

coffee.title: Coffee for the night shift
coffee.body: Your rescued coffee is ready. Pip has set out cups for the staff who never make the daytime photos.
coffee.mug: Use Pip's repaired mug for the first cup.
coffee.mugReply: Same cup. Better company. Pip does not make a speech.
coffee.sell: Sell the extra cups to visitors.

bugs.title: Quality is a kindness
bugs.body: Quincy found the last fault before a parcel left. Nothing went wrong today. He is trying to explain why that deserves celebrating.
bugs.credit: Put his name on the release notes.
bugs.creditReply: He reads the line twice, then pretends to check the spelling.
bugs.habitat: Celebrate by the beetle's new home.
bugs.habitatReply: Two successful releases. Neither needed a cage.
bugs.deadline: Use the saved time to raise the quota.

cable.title: The unlabelled cable
cable.body: The desk is finally untangled. One cable remains. Both ends point into the wall, and Nixie insists it was not there before.
cable.label: Label it: do not unplug.
cable.labelReply: For the first time, the wall has a clear instruction.
cable.wall: Behind the skirting board is a button labelled NOT YET. It has been pressed from the other side.
cable.releaseReply: A click. The cable goes slack. Somewhere, a paperclip is free.
cable.leave: Leave a note for the next shift.
cable.leaveReply: Nixie writes: WE SAW IT TOO. Nobody should investigate alone.

callback.needsRecording: Ask Echo to record a reply first.
callback.needsHabitat: Help Quincy with the bug jar first.
callback.needsManual: Help Nixie document the gadget first.

ensemble.title: Room recipes
ensemble.intro: Three pieces, one purpose. Arrange them together in the named room. The benefit lasts while the complete set is placed there.
ensemble.active: In use · contributing to the company
ensemble.inactive: Stored pieces do not count. Arrange the missing pieces in this room.

quiet-corner.name: A little breathing room
quiet-corner.effect: A plant, a lamp, somewhere to put your feet. Station combos wait 10% longer.

proper-break.name: An actual break
proper-break.effect: The fish supervise the snacks. Resting morale rises by 3.

living-lab.name: Science with leaves
living-lab.effect: The plants are the control group. Company production gains 4%.

paper-trail.name: Everything in its place
paper-trail.effect: Fewer duplicate requisitions: purchases cost 2% less. One drawer is filing itself.

night-watch.name: Someone is watching
night-watch.effect: The keys match every door except one. Rare-event luck gains 4%. Check the monitors.

sprout-club.name: The smallest department
sprout-club.effect: Warmth, water, and unreasonable expectations. Morale recovers 8% faster. A leaf has signed the attendance sheet.

ensemble.selection: Arrange these pieces in {{room}}. Stored pieces or pieces in another room do not activate the recipe.

archive.title: Filed tomorrow
archive.body: The new catalogue is perfectly alphabetized. Under your company name sits a personnel file dated tomorrow. Its paper is still warm.
archive.return: Put it back. Tomorrow is not on today’s agenda.
archive.returned: The drawer shuts politely. Someone inside clears their throat.
archive.signature: The report describes a remarkably ordinary day. One line is wrong: “Nobody noticed the extra signature.” Beneath it, a space waits for yours.
archive.corrected: The ink fades, then returns as “Thank you.” A copy enters your restricted files.
archive.signed: Two golden nuts slide from the binding. The signature is yours. The handwriting is not.

security.title: Camera thirteen
security.body: The room has twelve cameras. Monitor thirteen shows the office three seconds ahead. In it, someone is about to wave.
security.wave: Wave first. It seems rude not to.
security.waved: The other office waves back, late. Everyone agrees not to measure the delay.
security.unplug: Unplug it and finish today’s work.
security.unplugged: The screen goes dark. For four minutes, every task arrives exactly on time.
security.trace: Use your cable training to trace the signal.
security.needsMastery: Reach 30 points in Cable Untangle first.
security.traced: The cable ends in an empty desk. A nameplate reads “VACANT, UNTIL RECENTLY.” You file the photograph.

incubator.title: The plant clocked in
incubator.body: The incubator’s attendance sheet has a new signature: a damp leaf print. The seedling is already leaning toward the coffee queue.
incubator.badged: Employee 24 declines a desk and requests a sunny windowsill. Its probation period is seasonal.
incubator.observed: You leave a blank form beside the pot. Something begins filling it out.
incubator.laterBody: The plant has deposited one golden nut. Its note says “rent”.

return.title: The previous tenant
return.body: New company. New paperwork. On the first windowsill sits the same plant, wearing a badge from the previous timeline. It has kept your seat warm.
return.welcome: Welcome it back. Keep the old badge.
return.welcomed: A leaf turns toward you. For once, the company remembers something worth keeping.
return.rent: Ask whether the rent crossed timelines too.
return.rented: Two golden nuts. No forwarding address.

unknown.title: An unindexed finding
unknown.body: The evidence survived. The department that named it did not leave a forwarding address.

memo_basement.title: A memo from below
memo_basement.body: The basement has a basement. The drawing stops there; the stair count does not.

basement_basement.title: Another flight down
basement_basement.body: A floor plan with a staircase drawn outside the paper.

break_room_nation.title: The break-room constitution
break_room_nation.body: Article one: nobody is too important to wash their own mug.

chair.title: The extra chair
chair.body: Nobody ordered it. The upholstery remembers everybody.

fire_science.title: A revised safety procedure
fire_science.body: Step one is now underlined. So is the signature of the extinguisher.

ghost.title: A transparent appointment
ghost.body: No reflection. Excellent attendance. Payroll would like clarification.

negative_nut.title: The missing quantity
negative_nut.body: One nut less than an empty drawer. Counting it makes the room quieter.

nutcoin.title: A discontinued currency
nutcoin.body: Backed by collective optimism and one very ordinary acorn.

secret_ledger.title: The second ledger
secret_ledger.body: Every entry balances. Nobody recognizes the expenses.

secret_requisition.title: Requisition without a sender
secret_requisition.body: The delivery was signed for before the request was written.

sideways.title: The lateral department
sideways.body: A corridor that fits between two neighboring rooms. The architect has stopped answering.

spreadsheet.title: An unsaved workbook
spreadsheet.body: Cell B12 keeps calculating what would have happened if you had gone home.

too_round.title: A geometrically suspicious nut
too_round.body: Perfectly round. Rolled uphill during inspection. Marked “probably fine”.

wind_chime.title: The indoor forecast
wind_chime.body: There is no draft in this room. The chime disagrees at lunchtime.

anomaly_tomorrow.title: Tomorrow’s corrected report
anomaly_tomorrow.body: Someone noticed. The document has amended its prediction.

anomaly_signature.title: Your other signature
anomaly_signature.body: Same name. Different handwriting. The payment cleared yesterday.

anomaly_wave.title: A delayed greeting
anomaly_wave.body: Security footage of the office waving to itself. The timestamps disagree politely.

anomaly_futureDesk.title: Vacant, until recently
anomaly_futureDesk.body: A desk with a warm seat and a cable connected to tomorrow.

anomaly_employee24.title: Personnel file 024
anomaly_employee24.body: Position: windowsill. Preferred working hours: daylight. Leaves available upon request.

anomaly_previousTenant.title: Something worth keeping
anomaly_previousTenant.body: The company changed timelines. A small plant declined to forget you.
